sentences.japanese: 笑いで誤魔化すと、亜美さんはさも不機嫌そうに眉を寄せた。
sentences.english: Ami frowned in a very un-amused way as I brushed her off with a laugh.

sentences.japanese: 彼は眉をひそめてそっぽをむいた。
出てきた男は眉をひそめていた。
sentences.english: The man who stepped out was frowning.

sentences.japanese: 主人は私のやり方に眉をひそめたようだった。
sentences.english: The boss seemed to frown on my method.
